comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
dog.chase: Dawg a run yuh dung! Step pon it!
Hush, dawg! Lef di car alone!
Every time! Di dog dem nuh business wid traffic.
Move, puppydog! Di man a drive!
goat.hit: Lawd have mercy — yuh lick dung di goat!
Brethren, dat was somebody goat! Respect di livestock!
Yuh fi watch out fah di goat dem, man. Now look weh happen.
Dat nuh look good. Goat nah forgive easily.
goat.nearmiss: Jah save! Dat was close — nearly lick dung di poor goat.
Easy nuh! Di goat dem have di right of way up here.
Wheeel! Barely miss it. Keep yuh eyes open!
